findings.title: Baked 3.0.6 bytes and the eventual @cipherstash/eql 3.0.6 release drift apart, or release order is inverted
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The baked 9b6dab78 digest is attested only by itself while the in-tree manifest is 3.0.5/accde003, and the relaxed lockstep test means drift or an inverted release order is not caught offline.

findings.title: Consumers with a stale vendored migrations/cipherstash/ fail db init or silently stay on the old bundle
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Re-emitting the baseline and adding the 3.0.6 invariant to head.json means stale vendored spaces (now including 3.0.5-from-main ones) make db init refuse the data-class edges, as the pinned DEFECT test shows; the mechanism partly predates this change.

findings.title: The 3.0.6 reinstall drops objects that depend on eql_v3 on every existing database, for a version-stamp-only release
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The 3.0.6 edge executes readVerifiedInstallSql(), whose bundle begins with DROP SCHEMA ... CASCADE, so existing databases (newly including those already at 3.0.5) lose dependent objects for a version-stamp-only change.
